metadata.title: System Security and Privacy Plan – Secure Virtualization Platform

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: System architecture and governance aligned with NIST SP 800-125 (Guide to Security for Full Virtualization Technologies).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for resiliency guidance related to containment, redundancy, workload isolation, and controlled recovery within shared execution substrates.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for virtualization-specific security guidance addressing hypervisor isolation, control-plane protection, VM lifecycle risk, and management interface security. This guidance informs Secure Virtualization platform design, while cyber resiliency intent is provided by NIST SP 800-184.

system-characteristics.description: A hypervisor-based virtualization platform providing isolated execution environments for multiple operating systems on shared physical hosts, with explicit controls over VM isolation, lifecycle artifacts, intra-host networking, and management plane risk.

authorization-boundary.description: Includes bare-metal hosts, hypervisors, virtualization management planes, VM images and snapshots, intra-host networking components, and supporting identity and automation systems.

users.title: Virtualization Platform Administrator
users.description: Responsible for hypervisor configuration, physical host integration, and virtual machine execution environments.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

users.title: Virtualization Security Operations
users.description: Responsible for monitoring hypervisor integrity, investigating security events, and responding to suspected platform compromise.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

users.title: Virtualization Management Plane Operator
users.description: Manages virtualization control planes, administrative APIs, and automation systems used to create, modify, migrate, and destroy virtual machines.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Privileged infrastructure management aligns with Systems Administrator responsibilities.

users.title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
users.description: Develops and maintains Infrastructure-as-Code and automation pipelines interacting with virtualization APIs.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: DevOps Engineer role per NIST NICE Framework.

users.title: Authorizing Official
users.description: Accepts residual risk associated with virtualization platform operation.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership role per NIST NICE Framework.

components.title: Secure Virtualization
components.description: Composite trust assertion for secure operation of hypervisor-based virtualization platforms.

control-implementation.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls are satisfied through virtualization platform trust patterns asserted by secure-virtualization. Detailed control logic is documented in component-definitions and inherited by this SSP.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access control is enforced through hypervisor privileged access management and virtualization management plane governance.
System and communication protection includes intra-host VM network isolation and hypervisor boundary controls.
Configuration management for VM images, hypervisors, and lifecycle artifacts is enforced via virtualization governance patterns.
System integrity is ensured through hypervisor integrity monitoring and lifecycle artifact protection.
Resilience and recovery for virtualization platforms are enforced via isolation and management-plane containment.
